name: smwgraphics-resplendent-global-graphics
title: Resplendent Global Graphics
description:
Replace the global graphics in SMW, like pipes and question blocks, with graphics that I drew, and think are prettier.

These graphics are mostly one-to-one replacements for SMW things, with the exception that I replaced the bush with some extra tiles I think are more useful - a mushroom platform, wide cloud, vine end, etc.

Swapping out one of the files lets you replace the diagonal pipe and climbing nets with some SMB3 stuff.
